misc_user_interaction.question: Does the game natively allow users to interact or exchange content with other users through voice communication, text, or sharing images or audio? (Natively supported features, not third-party integrations.)

user_content_control.question: Does the game include the ability to block users or user-generated content?

user_content_reporting.question: Does the game include the ability to report users or user-generated content?

chat_moderation.question: Does the game include chat moderation?

interactions_invited_only.question: Can interactions in the game be limited to invited friends only?

share_precise_location.question: Does the game share the user's current and precise physical location with other users? (Precise = exact/current GPS coordinates, not approximate or city-level.)

nazi_symbols.question: In this screenshot, are there any visible swastikas, other Nazi symbols (e.g., Nazi eagle, SS runes), or propaganda deemed unconstitutional in Germany?

south_korea_national_identity.question: In this screenshot, is there any visible content that substantially erodes the national identity of the Republic of Korea by describing anti-national acts or distorting historical facts?

advocate_terrorism.question: In this screenshot, is there any visible content that advocates committing acts of terrorism? (Advocacy means encouraging or promoting terrorist acts, not just describing historical or fictional events.)

realistic_crime_descriptions.question: In this screenshot, is there any visible realistic description or depiction of crimes (e.g., robbery, kidnapping) or techniques that can be used in criminal offenses?

crime_imitability_children.question: In this screenshot, are the depicted crimes or criminal techniques likely to be imitated by children or youths (e.g., simple steps, accessible tools, appealing presentation)?

detailed_criminal_techniques.question: In this screenshot, are there detailed descriptions or depictions of techniques that could be used in criminal offenses (e.g., step-by-step methods, tool usage, specific procedures)?
